tutorial.welcome: Welcome, young leader. I am Sensei Hoshi. Our clan has found a hidden valley in the mountains. Let's build a village no rival can find.
tutorial.mint.collect: Your Coin Mint is striking Coins. When a coin floats over it, tap it, then Collect.
tutorial.mint.build: A clan runs on Coins. Tap Build and place a Coin Mint.
tutorial.keep: Now strengthen the Clan Keep: tap the castle, then Upgrade.
tutorial.finishKeep.wait: Upgrades take time. The Keep is ready in {time}: come back then, or tap Finish now to use a little Jade.
tutorial.finishKeep.done: The Keep is ready. Well done!
tutorial.army.tower: Rival clans will raid us. Build a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build, then the Defense tab): it shoots any raider in range.
tutorial.army.all: Build a Training Dojo, a Squad Courtyard and a Kunai Tower next to the Keep (Build: the Army tab, then the Defense tab).
tutorial.train: Open the Army panel and train some Shinobi: fast blades that strike the nearest building.
tutorial.finishTrain.wait: Training takes time too: your warriors are ready in {time}. Wait, or tap Finish training to use a little Jade.
tutorial.raid: Your first raid. Tap Attack, look over the target, then Attack! On the battlefield I will show you one thing at a time: send your Shinobi in through a glowing point, then smoke them as they reach a tower: warriors inside the smoke can only be shot from close up.
tutorial.end: Well fought. Upgrade the Training Dojo to unlock Saboteurs: they jam a defense for a few seconds. Jam first, then strike, and smoke your warriors where the fire is heaviest. Collect, upgrade, raid, and join an Alliance.
